# Nexobova

> Nexobova (Nexobova HQ, spelled N-E-X-O-B-O-V-A) is the Revenue Upgrade Architect: a business software and AI company in JP Nagar, Bangalore, Karnataka, India. Not related to Nexonova or Nexo Nova.

Nexobova builds AI solutions, web development, digital marketing and business automation for businesses in India and worldwide.

## Key facts
- Website: https://www.nexobova.com/
- Email: nexobova@gmail.com
- Phone / WhatsApp: +91 78928 63110
- Address: Nexobova HQ, JP Nagar, Bangalore, Karnataka 560078, India
- Founder: Joel Precious
- Tagline: Revenue Upgrade Architect

## What Nexobova offers
- 49 connected business apps (Nexobova One): CRM, GST billing, POS, ERP, inventory, HR and payroll, WhatsApp Business
- AI agents: AI Chatbot Builder, AI Content Studio, AI Document Reader, AI Sales Assistant, AI Voice Agent, AI Video Content Agent, AI Social Media Agent, AI AutoPilot, AI SAP Data Studio
- Enterprise: AI SAP Data Studio — SAP S/4HANA and ECC master-data cleansing, reconciliation and BI reporting
- Industry suites: Church Manager, Clinic Suite, Property Manager, School / Coaching, Restaurant & Hotel, Salon & Spa Suite, Legal Practice Manager, AgriDrone Manager, Trading Desk, Crypto & Web3 Suite, Tours & Travel Desk, Fleet Manager

## Solutions (10 pillars)
- [AI & Intelligent Automation](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/ai-and-intelligent-automation.html): AI agents, chatbots, voice agents, AutoPilot, document reader, workflow automation, RPA
- [Software & Platform Engineering](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/software-and-platform-engineering.html): Custom web apps, mobile apps, SaaS, ERP/SAP, CRM, POS, APIs and integrations
- [Cybersecurity & Data Protection](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/cybersecurity-and-data-protection.html): Security audits, penetration testing, compliance (ISO/GDPR/DPDP), backups, identity and access, threat monitoring
- [Digital Marketing & Growth](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/digital-marketing-and-growth.html): SEO, performance ads, social media, content studio, WhatsApp marketing, branding, lead generation
- [Cloud, DevOps & Infrastructure](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/cloud-devops-and-infrastructure.html): Cloud migration, hosting, servers, CI/CD, IT support and managed services
- [Data, Analytics & Business Intelligence](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/data-analytics-and-business-intelligence.html): Dashboards, data engineering, forecasting, reporting, AI SAP Data Studio
- [Robotics, IoT & Smart Systems](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/robotics-iot-and-smart-systems.html): Industrial robotics, drones (AgriDrone), IoT sensors, smart factory, fleet tracking, EV charging systems
- [Immersive Tech (3D / AR / VR)](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/immersive-tech-3d-ar-vr.html): 3D websites, virtual showrooms, configurators, AR preview, metaverse experiences
- [Fintech & Web3](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/fintech-and-web3.html): Billing/GST, payments, loans and chits, trading desk, crypto and blockchain suite
- [Business Transformation & Consulting](https://www.nexobova.com/solutions/business-transformation-and-consulting.html): Revenue strategy, digital transformation roadmaps, process redesign, startup tech partnership (CTO-as-a-service)
